summary: Pages answer much faster, and an update no longer makes the web app hang.

fixes.title: Views answer in a fraction of the time
fixes.text: Navigation, the device page, a CI's findings and history, the Summary view and the audit trail now answer much faster, also during a run. Every view shows exactly the same rows.

fixes.title: The web app no longer hangs during updates
fixes.text: While an update changes the database, the web app shows a short notice that SecurityInsight is being updated and comes back by itself.

fixes.title: Faster runs at large installations
fixes.text: Unchanged findings are no longer rewritten on every run, and one step at large installations is many times faster. What SecurityInsight sends to your other systems is unchanged.

fixes.title: Updates no longer block pages at sign-in
fixes.text: An update no longer re-creates unchanged parts of the database, so pages read at sign-in are not blocked while it runs.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Slow page reads are logged, and the device page names each finding from the published run. Run records Invardia could not receive are kept and sent later.
